## Codex execution contract

**CGS-11 design and consent contract:** Treat source task APIs and automatic hooks as optional; if unavailable, keep a transparent in-session checklist and do not claim task creation or hook execution. Use available file tools and preserve their permission limits. Establish the changed sections from actual available version-control evidence, scan the entity registry and in-scope ADR references, and present the impact report before action. Preserve per-ADR resolution decisions and authorization for every actual write; do not silently rewrite dependent GDDs, ADRs, or traceability. No traceability is NOT ASSESSED, not no impact.
